exposure: delivery route (normal spontaneous delivery or cesarean section)
cohort: Pregnant patients with adnexal masses between 2012 and 2019
finding: Laparoscopic surgery for adnexal masses during early pregnancy appears to be safe and effective, with all patients in the study experiencing optimal postoperative recovery and normal spontaneous delivery at term.
mod_finding: This study on adnexal masses during pregnancy discussed the consideration of mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean) in patients with concurrent adnexal tumors and their effects on pregnancy outcomes.
